name: helm
description: A band above the prompt with context fill, a prompt-cache countdown with idle keep-warm, compact, handoff and its settings, and numbered next steps Claude suggests when it finishes a task

contextBand.title: Show the context and cache band
contextBand.description: The context bar, cache countdown and COMPACT, HANDOFF and USAGE buttons above the prompt. Keep-warm and next steps work either way.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request (5m or 1h)

autoKeepWarm.title: Auto keep-warm, then compact or hand off
autoKeepWarm.description: While idle, refresh the cache before it expires, then run the idle action

idleAction.title: Idle action
idleAction.description: What to do while idle once refreshes run out or context passes the threshold: compact this session, or hand off to a fresh one

keepWarmCount.title: Keep-warm refreshes
keepWarmCount.description: How many idle refreshes before running the idle action

handoffPercent.title: Idle action threshold (% of context)
handoffPercent.description: At or above this context fill, skip refreshes and run the idle action at the first expiry point

leadSeconds.title: Act this many seconds before expiry
leadSeconds.description: When to refresh or hand off, measured back from the cache expiring

nextSteps.title: Suggest next steps
nextSteps.description: Show numbered next-step buttons above the prompt when Claude finishes a task.

clickAction.title: Next step click action
clickAction.description: run: send the step at once. fill: put it in the prompt box to edit before pressing Enter.

autoFallback.title: Auto-suggest when Claude forgets
autoFallback.description: After a turn that changed things but suggested no next steps, ask the model for some (one extra cached request).
